theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the ranked leader (rank 1, score 1.183) with the strongest durability_bar (0.54) and is one of only two eligible themes, yet it carries a mean-revert hurst_tag and thin breadth (0.385). The validated risk-control leg (absolute-trend gate) still admits it; the lean is a trend-following continuation of the one dominant narrative, not a return forecast. Crowding is benign (z 0.6, not crowded).
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst_tag and breadth of 0.385 suggest the leadership is narrow and prone to reversal — the rank-IC on cross-sectional momentum is ~0, so this is an attention/focus lens, not alpha, and a single dominant narrative can unwind fast.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the only scorable theme with a proxy (3033.HK) but sits rank 13 with a deeply negative score (-0.797), ineligible, mean-revert hurst and negative crowding_z (-0.93). Under the absolute-trend gate (the one validated edge), this is a stay-out region. The discourage-to-avoid lean is condition-based de-risking, not a short or fade call.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst_tag can sometimes precede short-term bounces; negative crowding is not a buy signal and the rank-IC on momentum is ~0, so an avoid may miss a rebound that the detector is not designed to forecast.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: China Platform Megacaps shares the same proxy (3033.HK), is the lowest-ranked eligible-capable theme (rank 15, score -1.037), ineligible, mixed hurst and negative crowding_z (-0.85). The absence of any trend-gate eligibility plus deep negative score places it structurally outside the tradable set under the one validated risk-control discipline.
theses.dissent: A mixed hurst_tag is less definitively mean-reverting than the other tech theme, and ultra-negative crowding is not a timing signal; an avoid could be early if the policy backdrop shifts and mean-reversion lifts the whole tech complex.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK (China Platform Megacaps) turns eligible or sees its score move above -0.5 before the 20-day check-by date
